subject: Q3 Executive headcount decision package — approvals requested
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 09:12:05 -0700
Subject: Q3 Executive headcount decision package — approvals requested
Cc: 

Team,

Attached is the consolidated decision pack for the Q3 executive hiring slate (PDF + comp bands). TL;DR: we are asking for approval to extend offers for three senior hires and to commit headcount for two bench roles that enable scale for Product and Platform. Key asks below — please respond with approval or feedback by EOD Monday, May 3 so we can proceed with final offer letters.

Summary (high level)
- CTO candidate (external search): request approval for band and signoff on total comp band; target start Q3 week 1.
- Head of Platform (internal/external mix): approve HC and proposed band.
- VP Product Growth: approve HC + discretionary sign-on pool.
- Bench: Senior Infra Eng (2 FTEs) — commit HC; hires are non-exec but need headcount hold.

Attached: Q3_exec_hc_pack_v3.pdf, comp-band-proposal.xlsx
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Q3ExecHCpack

Notes and constraints
- Compensation committee cadence next Thursday — this approval will authorize offers to go out while we finalize committee paperwork.
- Budget: finance has reserved the allocation pending final confirmation; see page 7 of the pack for funding sources.

Ask from each approver
- Marcus: confirm CTO band and whether to bump hiring manager discretionary pool.
- Aditya: confirm budget runway ok to consume by Q3.
- Lauren: confirm recruiting support and timeline for offers.
- Vivek: executive signoff / any strategic holds.

If I don’t hear objections by EOD Monday we will proceed with verbal offers and instruct Legal/People to prepare.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Head of Talent Operations, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0199

Atts: Q3_exec_hc_pack_v3.pdf (decision pack, 18 pages), comp-band-proposal.xlsx (salary bands and ranges)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 11:38:20 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 Executive headcount decision package — approvals requested
Cc: 

Soojin,

Thanks for the pack — quick read. I support the hires in principle but need clarity on the CTO total comp numbers. The comp-band-proposal.xlsx shows a midpoint that is ~8% above our published exec band for FY27; given market movement that may be fine, but we should either: 1) request a narrow band exception with Finance signoff, or 2) tighten the offer guidance and reserve a discretionary sign-on pool rather than inflate base.

Also: can you confirm whether the Head of Platform role is being recruited as an IC replacement or new capacity? That impacts the runway math.

If we plan to move forward with a candidate this week I prefer we keep the verbal offer conservative and allow room for a sign-on to bridge expectations.

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
CRO, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Soojin / Marcus —

Quick budget flag from Finance: the headcount commitment exceeds the Q3 hiring cap by 1.5 FTEs once we net the deferred contractor work. We have two pragmatic options: push the Bench Senior Infra Engs to Q4 or reallocate one of the bench roles budget to cover the incremental comp for the CTO band this cycle. I will need a written confirmation of the reallocation before we finalize offers so Finance can adjust the model and communicate to FP&A.
